summary: Lifezone Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its existing $60 million senior secured bridge loan facility with Taurus Mining Finance Fund No. 2, L.P. The amendment extends the availability period from August 29, 2026 to November 29, 2026. No new capital, pricing, or structural changes were disclosed; the filing is a routine debt facility modification. This does not constitute a special situation as it is a standard contractual extension with no event-driven catalyst. There is no deal, activist, strategic review, or other special-situation element involved.
